description: Defines the interface for EGL implementation factory classes, including methods for creating various EGL and graphics objects such as surfaces, images, contexts, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: EGLImplFactory
classes.description: Abstract factory interface for creating EGL and graphics objects, with methods for creating surfaces, images, contexts, and synchronization objects.

methods.name: createWindowSurface
methods.description: Creates a window surface for EGL rendering.

methods.name: createPbufferSurface
methods.description: Creates a pixel buffer surface for offscreen rendering.

methods.name: createPbufferFromClientBuffer
methods.description: Creates a pixel buffer surface from a client buffer.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates an image object for EGL.

methods.name: createStreamProducerD3DTexture
methods.description: Creates a stream producer for D3D textures.

methods.name: createExternalImageSibling
methods.description: Creates an external image sibling object (default implementation unreachable).

methods.name: createSync
methods.description: Creates an EGL synchronization object (default implementation unreachable).
